Problem Statement:
Raju is in horror land, which is 13-dimensional. The dice in horror land have 13 faces. When a die is thrown there are 13 possible outcomes from 1 to 13. N dice are thrown simultaneously. Find the number of possible outcomes. 
Input Description:
The only line of input contains an integer N. 
Output Description:
Print a line, the number of possible outcomes. Since the answer can be very large, print it modulo 1,000,000,007 
Explanation:
No. of outcomes for a single die is 13 
Sample Input:
1 
Sample Output:
13
